asked.text:
I run a B2B SaaS. Each of my customer companies should get their own
workspace with a feedback board. People in a workspace can submit
feedback, upvote, and leave comments. Teammates join via email invite.
Some users are admins for their workspace and can edit workspace
settings (name, slug, webhook URL).

understood.text: I'm moving on to workspace settings actions, planning admin-only updates and webhook secret regeneration, then invite actions for creating, accepting, and revoking invites.
